plugin_description: Bar and desktop widgets that render a Home Assistant Jinja template via the /api/template endpoint.

widget.no_template_tip: Set this widget's template_file to a Jinja template (see example.jinja).

errors.not_configured: Set the Home Assistant URL and token in plugin settings.

credentials_file.label: Credentials file
credentials_file.description: Path to a secret file with two lines, the Home Assistant URL then a long-lived access token. Takes precedence over the inline values.

base_url.label: Home Assistant URL
base_url.description: Base URL of the instance, e.g. https://ha.example.com or a Nabu Casa URL.

token.label: Access token
token.description: A long-lived access token (HA profile page). Ignored when a credentials file is set.

insecure_tls.label: Skip TLS verification
insecure_tls.description: Disable certificate and hostname verification. Only for a trusted endpoint on a private network.

template_file.label: Template file
template_file.description: Path to the Jinja template to render (required). Not bundled; see example.jinja. An agenix secret path works.

poll_seconds.label: Poll interval
poll_seconds.description: How often the template is re-rendered, in seconds.

dashboard_path.label: Dashboard path
dashboard_path.description: Path appended to the HA URL when the widget is clicked, e.g. /lovelace/home.

font_family.label: Font family
font_family.description: Override the bar font for this widget. Must be an installed family.

title.label: Title
title.description: Optional heading shown above the grid. Empty for no heading.

columns.label: Columns
columns.description: Items per row. 1 is a vertical list; set it to your item count for a single row; in between is a grid.

cell_width.label: Cell width
cell_width.description: Fixed width per cell in pixels, so columns line up on a constant pitch. 0 uses each item's natural width.

cell_height.label: Cell height
cell_height.description: Fixed height per cell in pixels. 0 follows the text height.

cell_align.label: Cell alignment
cell_align.description: Where the text sits inside a fixed-width cell.

column_gap.label: Column gap
column_gap.description: Horizontal space between cells, in pixels.

row_gap.label: Row gap
row_gap.description: Vertical space between rows, in pixels.

font_size.label: Font size
font_size.description: Text size for the rows in the desktop widget.
